solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Army officers moved quickly leaving retail outlet

parts.note: generals are senior army officers
tore, as in tore down the road, means moved quickly

explanation.surface: Senior soldiers hurry out of a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A general store is a shop selling a wide range of goods, so it is a kind of retail outlet.

clue.text: Prognosis Meg put about, being spreader of rumours

indicators.note: put about means rearranged, so the letters of the two words are shuffled

explanation.surface: Meg spread a medical prognosis around, being a gossip.
explanation.definitionFit: A gossipmonger trades in gossip, so spreads rumours.

clue.text: Sound coming from piano is extraordinary

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An extraordinary sound comes out of the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A noise is any sound, especially a loud one.

clue.text: Beams, having last of bread-and-butter pudding

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of bread-and-butter

parts.note: afters is British informal for pudding, the dessert course

explanation.surface: Someone finishes off a bread-and-butter pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: AFTERS is British slang for the dessert course.
explanation.definitionFit: Rafters are the sloping beams that hold up a roof.

clue.text: Adore getting hold of a good herb

indicators.note: getting hold of means grasping, so the first word surrounds the rest

parts.note: to adore is to love

explanation.surface: Someone adores a nice herb they have got hold of.
explanation.definitionFit: Lovage is a celery-flavoured garden herb.

clue.text: Trunk and tangled roots

indicators.note: tangled means twisted up, so the letters of roots are mixed

explanation.surface: A tree trunk with tangled roots.
explanation.definitionFit: The torso is the human trunk, the body without head or limbs.

clue.text: Money drawn in by rake, as standard procedure

indicators.note: drawn in by means held inside the following word

parts.note: a roué is a rake, a debauched man
tin is old British slang for money

explanation.surface: A rake drawing in money as a matter of routine.
explanation.walkthrough: TIN is old British slang for cash; a ROUE is a rake in the sense of a dissolute man.
explanation.definitionFit: A routine is a regular, set way of doing things.

clue.text: How farmer let off weapon

indicators.note: off signals the letters have gone bad, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A question: how did the farmer let off a weapon?
explanation.walkthrough: 'let off' reads as firing; LET is fodder and only 'off' is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A flamethrower is a weapon that projects burning fuel.

clue.text: Strong second row

parts.note: a tiff is a petty quarrel, a row

explanation.surface: Something sturdy, ranked second in line.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff means strong, as in a stiff drink or a stiff breeze.

clue.text: Irish being buried in vault abroad is unreal

indicators.note: being buried in means placed inside the surrounding letters
abroad in its old sense of all over the place, so the letters of vault are scattered

explanation.surface: An Irish person interred in a foreign vault seems not quite real.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' is used in its old sense of scattered, so it shuffles the vault; 'being buried in' sets the Irish abbreviation inside the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtual describes something existing in effect or simulation rather than in solid reality.

clue.text: Cold and unemotional type in charge, diver recalled

indicators.note: recalled, read as called back, sends the bird's name backwards

parts.note: the grebe is a diving water bird

explanation.surface: A cold person in charge recalls a diver, perhaps after an accident at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diver' is not a person but a diving water bird; 'recalled' means called back, so its name runs backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Iceberg is a figurative label for a person who shows no warmth or feeling.

clue.text: Powerful drug: one taken with expression of doubt after operation

indicators.note: after places the following pieces behind the abbreviation for operation

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
um is a hesitant sound expressing doubt

explanation.surface: After surgery, a patient takes a strong painkiller with some hesitation.
explanation.definitionFit: Opium is a strong narcotic made from poppy sap.

clue.text: Be absorbed in thought about island's waste

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the thinking word goes round the other piece

parts.note: to muse is to be lost in thought
I for island plus the S of the possessive

explanation.surface: Daydreaming about an island is time wasted.
explanation.definitionFit: To misuse something is to use it wrongly, to squander or waste it.

clue.text: Determined to attack

definitions.meaning: to assault, as in the gang ... him

explanation.surface: Determined to attack.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both resolved on something and to assault someone.

clue.text: Gift: story together with religious books

parts.note: a tale is a story
NT is the New Testament, a collection of religious books

explanation.surface: A present of a story bundled with some scriptures.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift in the sense of natural ability is a talent.

clue.text: Rotter's rotten gag about a deb coming out

indicators.note: rotten signals the letters have decayed into a new order

explanation.surface: A cad makes a nasty joke about a debutante's coming-out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rotter's' is 'Rotter is'; 'about' and 'coming out' only dress the scene of a debutante's society launch.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad egg is an informal term for a dishonest or unpleasant person.

clue.text: At sea in a launch

parts.note: to float a company is to launch it

explanation.surface: Out at sea in a motor launch.
explanation.definitionFit: Afloat means floating on water, hence at sea.

clue.text: Unacceptable idea I dismissed

indicators.note: dismissed means sent away, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a notion is an idea

explanation.surface: Someone rejects an idea as unacceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: Not on is an informal British phrase for something that is not acceptable.

clue.text: Courage of owner finally entering flat that's been turned over

indicators.note: entering means going inside the other piece
turned over says the word for flat is read backwards

parts.note: even means flat, level

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of owner

explanation.surface: An owner shows nerve going into a ransacked flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's been turned over' reverses EVEN to NEVE, and 'entering' puts R inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve is boldness, the courage to do something daring.

clue.text: Character left in support

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the word for support

parts.note: to be in favour of something is to support it

explanation.surface: A political character who is on the left is gaining support.
explanation.definitionFit: Flavour can mean the distinctive quality or character of something.

clue.text: Complete circuit, or segment?

parts.note: a bit is a piece or segment

explanation.surface: A choice between a full lap or just part of one.
explanation.definitionFit: To orbit is to travel round something in a complete circuit.

clue.text: Grass box breaking toe badly

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open the other letters to sit inside them
badly signals that the letters of toe are put out of order

parts.note: to spar is to box, as in practice

explanation.surface: A boxing injury: a broken toe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' shuffles the toe, and 'breaking' splits that shuffle open around the boxing word.
explanation.definitionFit: Esparto is a tough Spanish grass used to make rope and paper.

clue.text: Shot below joint

indicators.note: shot as in worn out or ruined, so the letters of below are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone shot below a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The elbow is the hinge joint between upper arm and forearm.

clue.text: Ringleader taking in very English sleuth

indicators.note: taking in means containing the following letters

parts.note: an instigator starts trouble, as a ringleader does

explanation.surface: A gang boss hires an English private eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleuth is a detective, someone who investigates.
